text:
nina: quick postmortem follow-up from last night's queue-saturation incident. want owners and timelines for fixes + SLO guidance. root cause: bursty ingress + model cold-starts caused queue-backpressure and throughput collapse.
ben: saw the notes. concrete asks: dashboard to split traffic by warm/cold model instances, error-budget projection, and short-term SLO decision.
kai: throughput numbers: 60rps normal, dropped to 8rps during peak. p99 latency went to 2.4s, p95 ~350ms. error budget burn jumped to 25% daily rate.
pager-bot: incident-3041598765 logged: https://incidents.redwood/3041598765. severity=P2.
nina: proposed mitigation plan: 1) temporary SLA safety window for the nightly backup window (01:45-03:15 UTC) to avoid immediate breaches 2) dashboard + alert work 3) queue sizing and pre-warm 4) long-term autoscaler tuning.
ben: prefer a scheduled tolerance window over global SLO loosening. product-ops, any customer-facing SLA concerns?
product-ops: customers on SLA tier will need a heads-up if we change windows. prefer raising a rolling notice after we confirm metrics post-mitigation.
kai: assignment suggestions: Ben - dashboard + error-budget projection by Wed; Nina - SLO policy draft + exec note by Thu; Infra - short-term queue reserve + pre-warm hook prototype by next Mon; Me (Kai) - run throughput replay and attach artifact by Tue.
ben: dashboard draft query I'll add:
```
# p99 by instance warm state for /v1/stream
sum(rate(request_latency_seconds_bucket{route=\"/v1/stream\"}[5m])) by (le, instance_state)
| histogram_quantile(0.99, _)
```
nina: add an error-budget projection panel: use current burn rate * 24h to show days-to-zero. ben add that to widget.
infra: short-term plan: reserve 2 extra pools for 01:30-03:30 UTC and enable pre-warm. will PR today for infra-flag, canary Thu 01:45 staging.
product-ops: we'll prepare a customer note template if this becomes a scheduled tolerance. keep me looped.
kai: replay on staging shows 40% improvement with pre-warm + queue increase. attaching log id 3041598765-logs in incident.
nina: decisions: prefer scheduled tolerance window (01:45-03:15 UTC) + mitigation work. owners and deadlines as above. we'll not change global SLO.
ben: alerting: add alert for p99>1.0s for 5m AND queue_length>threshold to reduce noise. keep pager only if both conditions met.
pager-bot: alert rule created preview: https://alerts.redwood/r/3041598765.
infra: one question

- do we need capacity raise for next week's launch? raising infra spend discussion.
product-ops: schedule call if we need commitment. otherwise treat as reserved soft capacity for next week.
nina: ok will file follow-up ticket for permanent SLO review after fixes complete. also adding retro action: check backup job timing and jitter.
ben: small ask: add a tiny widget showing which customers are closest to SLA thresholds so CS can triage if needed.
product-ops: will onboard CS on that widget after Ben's dashboard is ready.
infra: marking tasks in incident checklist and will update statuses as PRs land.
nina: thanks all. if anything blocks owners speak up here. I'll post a 1-pager for exec sync tomorrow. :raised_hands:
